deadline.value: International applicants apply (with all documents) by March 31, 2027 for September 2027 entry; the domestic deadline is May 31. Incomplete applications are declined.
deadline.quote: Outcomes will be communicated to applicants approximately two months after the deadline. | International Deadline Fall Term September May 31 Documents due: May 31 March 31 Documents due: March 31

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: A faculty member must agree to supervise you; apply only after a potential supervisor shows interest.
supervisor.quote: Supervisor approval is required to apply | This program requires you to have a supervisor. | An applicant cannot be admitted into an Engineering graduate program unless a faculty member agrees to supervise their graduate program.

funding.value: Most thesis-based engineering graduate students are funded; PhD students are eligible for research or teaching assistantships and supervisor-nominated scholarships.
funding.quote: Most thesis-based graduate students in the College of Engineering receive funding during their studies (e.g., scholarships, stipends, awards, research fellowships and teaching assistantships). | M.Sc. and Ph.D. students are eligible for financial support in the form of research assistantships or fellowships, as well as teaching assistantships.

entry_route.value: A thesis-based master's degree (70%+) is required for the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Master’s degree (thesis-based), from a recognized university in a relevant academic discipline
